CREATE TABLE "app"."client_contacts" (
  "client_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz(6) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "created_by" uuid,
  "email" character varying(254),
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "is_attendance_sender" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "name" character varying(120) NOT NULL,
  "phone" character varying(20),
  "role" text NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'ACTIVE' NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "updated_by" uuid,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "client_contacts_role_check_ee81f616" CHECK ("role" IN ('HR', 'ACCOUNTS', 'SITE_INCHARGE', 'OTHER')),
  CONSTRAINT "client_contacts_status_check_ee520df2" CHECK ("status" IN ('ACTIVE', 'INACTIVE'))
)
